title: Support for Preschools Grappling with COVID-19 Rules and Manpower Shortage Given Rise in Cases
what_it_is: Support for Preschools Grappling with COVID-19 Rules and Manpower Shortage Given Rise in Cases

sections.label: Preschool COVID-19 funding and tracing
sections.summary: ECDA funded preschools to hire Safe Management Assistants in 2020 and 2021, and streamlined contact tracing with MOH ahead of the Omicron wave.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: ECDA also provided preschools with funding support in 2020 and 2021 to hire Safe Management Assistants to help implement safe management measures (SMMs).

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To help preschools manage COVID-19 cases ahead of the Omicron wave, ECDA and MOH have streamlined the contact tracing processes and empowered preschools with greater autonomy to manage their COVID-19 cases.

sections.label: Preschool manpower deployment flexibility
sections.summary: With staff fully vaccinated and on weekly RRT, ECDA gave operators more manpower flexibility, including deploying MTL teachers across preschools and initiating business continuity plans.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As all preschool staff are now fully vaccinated and are placed on weekly Rostered Routine Testing (RRT), ECDA has provided operators with more flexibility in manpower deployment within each preschool.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In areas where manpower is very tight, such as Mother Tongue Language (MTL) teachers, such staff may be deployed across preschools, subject to prevailing SMMs.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In situations where preschools are impacted by substantial staff absenteeism, ECDA works closely with the operators to initiate their business continuity plan, such as adjusting programme plans and allowing flexibility in staffing ratios.

sections.label: ART kits for preschools
sections.summary: A suggestion on additional ART kit support is being explored, and kits were issued to preschools and children around September last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: On the first question on additional support in terms of ART kits, I think that is something we can take back and explore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Last year, sometime around September, we had done the same.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We issued some kits to the preschools, children, to alleviate the stress on the families of having to test regularly for the children.

sections.label: Keeping preschools open
sections.summary: At this phase of the pandemic, ECDA wants preschools to remain open as much as possible to minimise social impact from closures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: So, we are striking a right balance and we are mindful of the constraints that preschools face, we are mindful of the stress that preschools have to handle and deal with as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: But as much as possible, at this phase of the pandemic, we want our preschools to remain open as much as possible so that social impact arising from preschool closures are kept to the minimum.
